player_prompt.intro:
Nang chyu ai {difficulty} RushHour hkrang hta. Car sha hte [X] na mat wa ai, right edge htung na htawng da ai.
Actions: [A+], [B-], etc.  (+ = forward, - = backward).

invalid_move.wrong_format: Hkum hpe gaw sha ai. [A+] / [B-] format num sha re.
invalid_move.no_car: Dai hta mawdaw "{car_id}" mung n lawm ai.

game_message.solved: Hkyeng ai mawdaw gaw, grau kaba wa sai. Nang dai manghkang hpe hparan kau nu ai.
